reuse.why: Adds a sibling guard in the existing link.ts helper module beside ensureAccountIsNotLinked; it could have been folded into that existing pre-link check, so each handler now makes two guard calls.

duplication.why: The closed-account rule and message exist once; the six handlers only call it.

placement.why: link.ts is where the tree keeps the shared pre-link checks, and every provider handler calls it before any write.

scope.why: Only the guard, its six call sites and unit tests.

maintainability.why: Clear single rule, though the call is placed slightly inconsistently across handlers (before or after the existing guard and institution setup) and pre-link checks are now two separate calls per provider.

one_place.where: ensureAccountIsOpen in server/accounts/link.ts, called by all six provider link handlers in accounts/app.ts.
